Note that it works in AngularJS.

rename.to: Literal Array trailing comma in expressions causes error

body:
It's even not just arrays, but also objects. The following returns a syntax error when parsing the template during `ng serve`: ```
Lorem
``` This is compiled without errors, tho: ```
Lorem
``` Both are valid Typescript. Since Typescript 2.9 traling commas are not allowed, but only on rest parameters (see [breaking changes description](https://github.com/Microsoft/TypeScript/wiki/Breaking-Changes#trailing-commas-not-allowed-on-rest-parameters) and [related fix](https://github.com/Microsoft/TypeScript/pull/24672)). Both should compile without errors, so I guess this is a bug with the way Angular compiles the templates, right?
@mhevery, I believe this is wrongly tagged as "feature" instead of "bug/fix" for the reasons exposed above.
